title: This sub gave some great feedback
author: Grox_are_shitty
selftext:
Last week I posted up my game: Boat! And a lot of you graciously took the time to provide a lot of good feedback. Ive spent the week implementing and changing things mostly based off what Ive heard here.

\- The biggest one is an online leaderboard. It is all routed through a backend on my personal website.

\- rebalancing difficulty, the game should now be easier to get going.

\- verticality of shot has been given visualization and tool tips. You also can not shoot through waves anymore.

\- ramming is now an upgradeable and legitimate Playstyle.

\- went with a slightly more painterly styled aesthetic. All shaders and textures modified.

\- wind plays a bigger role, although to keep an arcade feel, you can still sorta float into it.

\- sails are now a full cloth simulation, although they need more work.

\- major UI rework.

\- shallow waters are less stupid.

\- mobile and controller support.

\- canonball animations and timing have been made more realistic. Also smoke.

\- better instructions (I hope).

\- floating items pick up automatically.

\- ready to fire is more obvious.

\- distance measurements are all nautical now.

\- stand alone windows version.

I still have much work to do, but wanted to share this cumulative update as about 80% of the feedback came from this sub. More feedback always welcome. I posted my score to the leaderboard, I will be delighted if someone beats it!

https://nateharmsfpv.itch.io/boat
